## Activity

During October 2018, East City Eye Clinic completed 185 captures. This report records the activity completed during the month and summarises image quality and grading outcomes. The capture total provides the basis for reviewing the service’s performance for the reporting period.

## Image quality

Of the 185 captures, 2 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 1.1 per cent. This result should continue to be monitored as part of routine site operations and image-quality review. Any recurring camera issues should be logged with the service desk so that they can be followed up through the appropriate process.

## Grading

Grading identified 25 referable results. The median lag from photograph to grading was 2 days. This provides a summary measure of the time between image capture and completion of grading during October 2018. The site should continue to review grading activity alongside capture volumes and image quality, with particular attention to the ungradable rate and the time taken for results to progress through the service.
